# @appolabs/sdk

> JavaScript bridge SDK for native app features in React Native WebViews.

The SDK provides a unified API for accessing native device capabilities (push notifications, biometrics, camera, location, haptics, storage, share, network, device info, NFC) from web applications running inside React Native WebViews. Communication uses a request/response bridge over `window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage()` with automatic browser fallbacks for non-native environments.

## Appo ecosystem (this SDK is one piece)

Appo wraps an already-hosted web app in a native iOS/Android React Native WebView; this SDK is the runtime bridge. Related resources:

- **Detect the wrapper:** `getAppo().isNative`, or `typeof window.ReactNativeWebView !== 'undefined'` — never `navigator.standalone` / `display-mode: standalone` (PWA signals, false inside the RN WebView).
- **CLI** `@appolabs/appo` — create, try and publish apps from a terminal or agent (parity with the dashboard).
- **MCP connector** `https://apps.goappo.io/mcp` — remote server with OAuth sign-in for AI assistants (`create_app`, `configure_app`, `preview_app`, `publish_app`, …); `npx @appolabs/appo mcp` registers it in Claude Code and Codex. The `@appolabs/appo-mcp` package is retired.
- **Dashboard:** `https://apps.goappo.io` — the same apps and lifecycle in a web interface.
- **REST API:** `/api/v1` — OpenAPI at `https://apps.goappo.io/docs/api/v1.json`.
- **Native shell:** built and published by Appo; nothing is installed in the site.
- **Layout fixes without changing the site:** CSS/JS applied by the shell at load time, set through the connector's `customize_appearance` tool.

## Documentation

- [Dashboard, CLI or MCP?](https://goappo.io/docs/getting-started/which-tool) — Same outcomes, three ways to drive them: pick the surface that fits your workflow
- [From URL to the stores](https://goappo.io/docs/getting-started/journey) — The publishing journey: create, preview, publish, update, and reach app stores
- [Installation](https://goappo.io/docs/sdk/installation) — Install @appolabs/sdk and configure for your app
- [Create an app](https://goappo.io/docs/guides/create-app) — Start an Appo project from a URL or existing website
- [Preview on device](https://goappo.io/docs/guides/preview) — Test your app on iOS and Android before publishing
- [Publish to app stores](https://goappo.io/docs/guides/publish) — Submit your app to the Apple App Store and Google Play
- [Update your app](https://goappo.io/docs/guides/update) — Deploy your site and the app follows; name and icon land with the next operated build
- [Push notifications](https://goappo.io/docs/guides/push) — Add push messaging to your app
- [Handle App Store rejections](https://goappo.io/docs/guides/rejection) — The curated required action, the fix recipe, and resubmission
- [Test builds](https://goappo.io/docs/guides/test-builds) — Installable test binaries (CLI and MCP)
- [CLI documentation](https://goappo.io/docs/cli) — The appo CLI: install, appo ship, command reference
- [CLI: appo ship](https://goappo.io/docs/cli/ship) — Publish an app to the stores
- [CLI: command reference](https://goappo.io/docs/cli/commands) — Every appo command and flag
- [MCP documentation](https://goappo.io/docs/mcp) — Drive the app lifecycle from your AI assistant through the remote Appo connector
- [MCP: tool reference](https://goappo.io/docs/mcp/tools) — Every tool exposed by the MCP server, with outcomes and confirm gates
